title: Mosquito Moon
description: A large cracked moon dominates a surreal purple dreamscape, covered with realistic mosquitoes feeding from its surface. An infinite arched corridor recedes into the starry distance while a gnarled tree and reflective water sit in the foreground, all contained within a weathered wooden frame pinned with nails and dried leaves.
prompt: Surreal painting of a massive cracked yellow moon floating in a purple arched hallway that recedes infinitely into a starry void. Several realistic mosquitoes are attached to the moon's surface. Purple smoke with calligraphic symbols drifts across the scene. In the foreground, a twisted tree grows beside dark reflective water that mirrors the moon and insects. The entire scene is displayed within an old wooden frame with nails and dried leaves along the edges.
